Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.annotations

package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.annotations
This package contains:
  • Subclasses of Annotation, which represents metadata attached to OMERO entities.
  • AnnotationCreator to create annotations from JSON.
  • Classes used internally.
